component.name: INIS Online
component.summary: A digital adaptation of the Celtic area-control board game

description.p: INIS Online is a cross-platform, fan-made digital adaptation of the Celtic card-drafting and area-control board game. Play online, over LAN, in local hotseat, or against AI opponents. This project uses original artwork and re-implemented rules text; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original publisher.
